description: Source code implementing platform service functions for Android in the Cobalt project, including opening, closing, and sending messages via a Java-based Cobalt service.

classes.name: CobaltExtensionPlatformServicePrivate
classes.description: Private structure holding context, callback, name, and Java object reference for the platform service.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if the Cobalt service exists with the given name.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a Cobalt platform service with specified context, name, and callback.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the specified Cobalt platform service.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data through the platform service and receives a response.
